central_question: Does group-level variance starvation prospectively predict useful-gradient availability across stacks and reward regimes, and can a boundary-aware ZVF controller improve held-out learning utility at matched compute over static group sizes and simpler heuristics?
decision_enabled: Decide whether the completed E1 audit can support a main-track mechanism-plus-controller paper, a mechanism-only negative-results paper, or neither.
out_of_scope: Universal claims about every GRPO-family method
Pooling the frozen E1 outcomes with the new experiment as if they were one preregistration
Treating prompt-level rows or rollout groups as independent training replicates
Changing a primary endpoint, margin, seed, arm, or expansion gate after a scored confirmatory run
Substituting a different accelerator or framework after a scored run without creating a new protocol version

H1_mechanism.claim: A pre-fit variance-starvation model using prompt success probability and group size predicts held-out zero-variance and useful-gradient rates on unseen task/model/group-size cells.
H1_mechanism.falsifier: The held-out 95% calibration interval misses the observed cell rate in more than 20% of cells, or the pooled absolute calibration error exceeds 0.05.

H2_controller.claim: Boundary-aware control improves learning-curve AUC under the same generated-token budget and reaches a static-G16 quality target with fewer total training FLOPs.
H2_controller.falsifier: The confirmatory pooled seed-paired AUC interval includes zero and the controller is not non-inferior at the final checkpoint, or its tokens/FLOPs-to-target are not lower than static G16.

H3_boundary_information.claim: Separating all-wrong starvation from all-correct saturation adds value beyond a symmetric ZVF trigger and an all-wrong-only retry rule.
H3_boundary_information.falsifier: The full controller does not improve the preregistered utility endpoint over the best naive heuristic, or fires the same decisions in at least 95% of eligible prompt-steps.

H4_stack_robustness.claim: After objective-level differential tests pass, the direction of the controller effect is preserved on a second open training stack.
H4_stack_robustness.falsifier: The secondary-stack replication changes the sign of the primary AUC effect or fails the final-quality non-inferiority margin.

mbpp_graded.reward: fraction of hidden unit tests passed, with all-tests-pass reported separately

arms.symmetric_zvf: Escalate all zero-variance groups from G=8 to G=16
arms.failure_only: Escalate all-wrong groups; do not spend additional rollouts on all-correct groups
arms.boundary_aware: Escalate all-wrong groups and retire mastered all-correct prompts using the frozen boundary thresholds
arms.full_triage: Boundary-aware policy plus Wilson uncertainty gating and the frozen compute-aware action rule

seeds.rule: Screening and confirmatory training seeds are disjoint; screening outcomes may choose among preregistered arms but never enter confirmatory intervals.

training.plateau_rule: A run may stop after step 300 only when the two most recent held-out checkpoints improve by less than the task non-inferiority margin and the stopping decision was made without arm labels.

budgets.secondary_matching: measured total training FLOPs including generation, policy/reference forward passes, and backward updates
requirements: Use an identical prompt order and token ceiling within each task/model/seed cell
Record realized generated tokens, environment executions, optimizer steps, measured wall time, and peak memory
Do not compare arms when realized generated tokens differ by more than 1% unless the endpoint is explicitly tokens-to-target
Freeze per-cell token and FLOP ceilings from dry-run profiles before screening

primary_endpoints.utility: Seed-paired difference in held-out learning-curve AUC per fixed generated-token budget, aggregated hierarchically across task/model cells.
primary_endpoints.efficiency: Seed-paired ratio of measured training FLOPs required to reach the static-G16 median final-quality target.
primary_endpoints.final_quality: Seed-paired held-out pass@1 difference at the common token ceiling.

analysis.independent_unit: training seed within a frozen task/model/stack cell
analysis.intervals: seed-paired bootstrap intervals with task/model cells retained as clusters; prompt-clustered intervals are secondary only
analysis.hierarchical_summary: random-intercept model for task and model with arm-by-regime interactions
analysis.multiplicity: Holm correction across H1-H4; no correction within a single ordered gate
analysis.equivalence: TOST at the task-specific non-inferiority margin
analysis.missingness: intention-to-treat; infrastructure interruptions resume exact checkpoints and do not create scientific failures
analysis.negative_result_rule: A confidence interval crossing zero is INCONCLUSIVE, not evidence of equivalence or failure.

S0_evidence_sync.acceptance: R08, audit.json, generated LaTeX macros, PDF, status, obligations, strict 40/40 verification, and corpus inventory agree.

S1_objective_differential.scope: TRL and verl on identical synthetic minibatches for GRPO and every controller action path.
S1_objective_differential.acceptance: Float64 losses, masks, importance ratios, selected group sizes, and flattened gradients agree with the canonical reference to rtol<=1e-6 and atol<=1e-8; every treatment differs from baseline on at least one targeted fixture and matches it on all frozen non-treatment fields.

S2_screening.scope: All six arms, Qwen3-1.7B, all three tasks, three screening seeds, primary stack, 100 steps.
S2_screening.expansion_gate: Advance only if full_triage has positive pooled AUC difference versus static_g16 and versus the best naive arm, is within the final-quality margin on every task, and improves either useful-gradient fraction or tokens/FLOPs-to-target by at least 10%.

S3_confirmatory.scope: full_triage, static_g16, and the screening-selected naive arm; two model scales, three tasks, five disjoint confirmatory seeds, primary stack, up to 400 steps.
S3_confirmatory.acceptance: The Holm-adjusted 95% interval for pooled AUC improvement excludes zero; final quality is non-inferior in every task/model cell; measured FLOPs-to-target is lower with a 95% paired interval excluding 1.0.

S4_secondary_stack.scope: The three confirmatory arms on verl for Qwen3-1.7B, one prespecified cell from each reward regime, and the five confirmatory seeds.
S4_secondary_stack.acceptance: Effect direction matches the primary stack and final quality remains within the task-specific non-inferiority margin.

publication_routes.flagship: S1-S4 pass: mechanism plus controller paper.
publication_routes.mechanism_only: H1 and H4 pass but H2 or H3 fails: predictive mechanism and negative controller result, with no controller-win claim.
publication_routes.bounded_negative_result: Only S1 and a surprising, deeply analyzed falsification pass: negative-results submission or workshop artifact.
publication_routes.stop: S1 fails, S2 expansion gate fails without a prospectively predictive mechanism, or confirmatory power is inadequate: do not spend the remaining matrix.

required_per_run: private Hugging Face checkpoints and final adapter
contiguous held-out trace with unique completion hashes
exact resume receipt for any interruption
provenance.external_release: No public upload or submission without explicit user approval.

stop_conditions: Do not start S2 until S1 passes on both stacks.
Do not start S3 if the S2 expansion gate fails.
Do not continue after three distinct guarded attempts reproduce the same infrastructure failure.
Do not purchase additional compute or storage; pause if existing capacity is insufficient.
Do not change the protocol after a scored confirmatory run; create a new version instead.
